# StrangerTalk

> StrangerTalk (strangertalk.in) is a free, anonymous random chat website for adults (18+) in India. Users are matched with a random stranger and can chat in Hindi, Hinglish or English without creating an account. The site is moderated and has community guidelines, reporting and a grievance officer as required by Indian law.

## Key pages
- [Home – start chatting](https://strangertalk.in/)
- [Omegle alternative for India](https://strangertalk.in/omegle-alternative.html)
- [Chat with strangers in Hindi](https://strangertalk.in/hindi-chat.html)
- [FAQ](https://strangertalk.in/faq.html)
- [Safety tips](https://strangertalk.in/safety-tips.html)
